name: Figment
description: You create a simple illusion of a sound or a stationary visual image. The sound can be as loud as a dozen normal voices, and the image fits within a 5-foot cube. It lacks sensory components beyond sound or sight.

name: Light
description: The object glows, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). If you cast this spell again on a second object, the light spell on the first object ends.
heightened: [b]Heightened (4th):[/b] The object casts bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

name: Message
description: You mouth words quietly, but they reach the target's ears as if you had spoken them directly to it. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn.

name: Summon Instrument
description: You conjure a handheld musical instrument of your choice. This instrument is typical for its type, and can be played to produce music. If you cast the spell again, the previous instrument vanishes.

name: Telekinetic Projectile
description: You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled.

name: Dizzying Colors
description:
A swirling array of flashing, dizzying colors springs from your hand. Each creature in the cone must attempt a Will save.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The creature is unaffected.
[b]Success:[/b] The creature is dazzled for 1 round.
[b]Failure:[/b] The creature is blinded for 1 round, dazzled for 1 minute.
[b]Critical Failure:[/b] The creature is stunned 1, blinded for 1 minute, and dazzled for 10 minutes.
[/ul]

name: Command
duration: until the end of the target's next turn
description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away, release what it's holding, drop prone, or stand in place. The target must attempt a Will save.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The creature is unaffected.
[b]Success:[/b] The creature is unaffected.
[b]Failure:[/b] The creature must use its first action on its next turn to obey your command.
[b]Critical Failure:[/b] The creature must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.
[/ul]
heightened: [b]Heightened (5th):[/b] You can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Charm
description:
You alter the target's loyalties to make it friendly toward you. If the target is hostile, it must first be brought to unfriendly. The target attempts a Will save.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to use magic to influence it.
[b]Success:[/b] The target is unaffected but doesn't realize you tried to use magic.
[b]Failure:[/b] The target's attitude becomes friendly toward you.
[b]Critical Failure:[/b] The target's attitude becomes helpful toward you.
[/ul]
heightened: [b]Heightened (4th):[/b] The duration increases to until your next daily preparations.

name: Soothe
description: You grace the target's mind, healing its body. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points. The target also gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

name: Animated Assault
description: You use telekinesis to animate pieces of debris and loose rubble, forming a swirling storm. Any creature in the area takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). When you sustain the spell, you can move the area up to 10 feet, and it deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex) to creatures in the area.
heightened: [b]Heightened (+2):[/b] The initial damage increases by 2d10, and the sustained damage increases by 1d10.

name: Cutting Insult
description:
You unleash an insult so vicious it physically cuts the target's ego and body. The target takes 4d6 mental damage and 1 persistent bleed damage, depending on a Will save.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] Unaffected.
[b]Success:[/b] Takes half damage, no bleed.
[b]Failure:[/b] Takes full damage, 1 persistent bleed damage, and is frightened 1.
[b]Critical Failure:[/b] Takes double damage, double persistent bleed damage, and is frightened 2.
[/ul]
heightened: [b]Heightened (+1):[/b] The mental damage increases by 2d6 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

name: Sonata Span
description: You play a beautiful melody that hardens into a shimmering bridge of solid force. The bridge spans up to 30 feet, connecting two solid points. It is 5 feet wide and can support any amount of weight.
heightened: [b]Heightened (+1):[/b] The maximum length of the bridge increases by 10 feet.

name: Phantom Prison
description:
You trap the target's mind inside a localized illusion of a tiny, windowless cell. The target must attempt a Will save.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The creature is unaffected.
[b]Success:[/b] The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and perception checks for 1 round.
[b]Failure:[/b] The target believes they are trapped in a small cell. They are flat-footed and cannot target anything outside their own square for 1 minute or until they use an interact action and succeed on a Will save to disbelieve the illusion.
[b]Critical Failure:[/b] As failure, but they take a –2 status penalty to the Will saves to disbelieve the illusion.
[/ul]

name: Cozy Cabin
description: You conjure a 20-foot-by-20-foot wooden cabin to provide shelter. It is comfortably furnished with beds, a table, and a small hearth with a fire. Up to six Medium creatures can fit comfortably. The cabin is climate-controlled and provides basic protection from the elements, but is not heavily fortified. Once the duration expires, the cabin vanishes.
heightened: [b]Heightened (+2):[/b] The cabin's dimensions increase by 10 feet in each direction, and it accommodates four more Medium creatures.

name: Shared Invisibility
description: You cloak yourself and your allies in invisibility. The targets become invisible as long as they remain within 30 feet of you. If any affected creature uses a hostile action, the spell ends for that specific creature, but remains active for the rest.

name: Courageous Anthem
description: You inspire your allies with words or tunes of encouragement. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects.

name: Rallying Anthem
description: You protect your allies with a rallying performance. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws, as well as resistance to physical damage equal to half the spell's rank.

name: Counter Performance
trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against an auditory or visual effect.
description: You protect yourself and your allies from harmful sounds or sights through a distracting performance. Roll a Performance check. You and allies in the area can use the better result between your Performance check and their saving throw.

name: Lingering Composition
description:
You add a flourish to your composition to extend its benefits. If your next action is to cast a composition cantrip with a duration of 1 round, attempt a Performance check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of a level equal to the highest-level target.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The composition lasts 4 rounds.
[b]Success:[/b] The composition lasts 3 rounds.
[b]Failure:[/b] The composition lasts 1 round, but you don't spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.
[/ul]

name: Hymn of Healing
description: Your divine song wards off death and accelerates recovery. The target gains fast healing 2. When you cast the spell and the first time you sustain it each round, the target gains 2 temporary Hit Points.
heightened: [b]Heightened (+1):[/b] The fast healing and temporary Hit Points each increase by 2.

name: Fortissimo Composition
description:
You put everything you have into your next performance, pushing its effects to their absolute limit. If your next action is to cast the [i]courageous anthem[/i] or [i]rallying anthem[/i] composition cantrip, attempt a Performance check. The DC is typically a very hard DC of a level equal to that of the highest-level target of your composition.
[ul]
[b]Critical Success:[/b] The status bonus from your composition increases to +3.
[b]Success:[/b] The status bonus from your composition increases to +2.
[b]Failure:[/b] The composition provides its normal bonus, but you don't spend the Focus Point for casting this spell.
[/ul]

name: Detect Magic
description: You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.
heightened:
[b]Heightened (3rd):[/b] You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect in range that the spell detects. If multiple effects tie for the highest level, you learn the school for one of them.
[b]Heightened (4th):[/b] As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic.
